Small, four-legged, '''long-snouted animals''' inhabited the [[Forest/Legends|forests]] and [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] of [[Dractu]],<ref name="CWA" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> They moved in groups and scattered when other creatures approached.<ref name="CWA" />
